title.tr: Aydınlatma direkli ve halat korkuluklu deniz iskelesi
title.en: Sea pier with lighting posts and rope railing

alt.tr: Denize uzanan ahşap iskele; kenarlarda lamba direkleri ve halat korkuluk, ucunda daha geniş bir platform
alt.en: Timber pier running out to sea with lamp posts and rope railing along the sides and a wider platform at the end

caption.tr: İskele tahtaları boydan boya yan yana döşenmiş. Kenardaki direkler halatla birbirine bağlanıyor.
caption.en: The deck boards run side by side along the full length. The posts at the edge are linked with rope.
